issues.title: Cancel & Save Button Color
issues.body:
Was just reviewing #1368 and realized that the Cancel and Save buttons are of the same color: 

![Cancel   Save Button Same Color](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85491794/157418471-08d7cfab-3ce9-41dd-be4d-3f0076e8f8be.png)

I suggest we stick to the usual bold navy blue for the save button and keep the grey for the cancel button.
